title: Direct Delivery / Channels Operations Contract v0
description: Frozen v0 contract for cross-boundary Direct Delivery and Channels operations. Gateway* DTO names are historical only; the Gateway compatibility alias routes (POST /api/gateway/direct-agent-messages, /api/gateway/events, /api/gateway/channel-activity-events, /api/gateway/test-wakes) were retired in task #2022 and return 410 Gone. Core remains workflow truth.

deliveryStatus.description: Operator-facing delivery status for direct-agent events.

claimStatus.description: Whether the delivery has been claimed by target runtime.

waitForTarget.description: Wait target vocabulary — historical only (task #2022). The Gateway compatibility alias using this path was retired.

messageKind.description: Channel message kinds. Matches SQLite CHECK constraint.

sourceKind.description: Source origin system/event type for channel messages.

wakePolicy.description: Wake policy controlling when agent membership generates wake pulse.

eventRecordingStatus.description: Top-level status for event recording responses.

traceSourceAvailability.description: Source availability signals for assignment trace.

deliveryMode.description: Delivery mode in direct-agent event metadata.

sourceContext.description: Source/control context: where the interaction happened.

targetWork.description: Workflow attribution for the target project work.

sessionOwner.description: Target durable agent instance/session for session reuse across channels.

v0.naming: Gateway* DTO names are retained for historical compatibility reference only. The Gateway alias routes were retired in task #2022 (410 Gone). Semantics are Direct Delivery / Channels operations.
v0.coreTruth: Core remains workflow truth for assignments, leases, runs, completion, release, quarantine.
v0.useStubProjectMetadata: Separate Channels↔Core integration concern; does not block Direct Delivery contract hardening.
